name: Montezuma Castle National Monument
story: Montezuma Castle National Monument protects a well-preserved cliff dwelling located in Camp Verde, Arizona. Constructed as early as 1125 AD by the Southern Sinagua people, the five-story structure sits up a limestone cliff and features stone-and-mortar masonry.
matters: The national monument encloses 860 acres near the geographic center of Arizona. It preserves important archaeological structures and houses a museum about the Native American communities with cultural connections to the site.
